metadata.description: Mock merchant risk profiles for RAG ingestion. Risk scores are illustrative.

high_risk_mcc_codes.description: Gambling — horse racing, dog racing, state lotteries
high_risk_mcc_codes.notes: FINTRAC requires enhanced monitoring for transactions > $500

high_risk_mcc_codes.description: Non-financial institutions — cryptocurrency, foreign currency exchange
high_risk_mcc_codes.notes: Common vehicle for converting fraud proceeds; monitor for structuring
Immediate alert for first-time users or amounts > $2000
High-resale-value goods; common ATO fraud target
Electronics resale; common CNP fraud target
Flag for unusual ATM locations or multiple withdrawals within 1 hour

known_fraud_merchants.risk_reason: Common card-testing merchant name used by fraud rings
Unlicensed online pharmacies often involved in transaction laundering
Cryptocurrency exchanges used to launder fraud proceeds

low_risk_merchants.notes: Major Canadian grocery chain; transactions are typically legitimate
Fast food; very low transaction amounts make fraud impractical
Gas stations; card-present. Monitor for skimming incidents.

regional_risk_modifiers.description: Adjust base fraud probability by region

regions.reason: High transaction density; higher CNP risk
Elevated crypto and money laundering activity
Transit hubs; legitimate travel creates geo-velocity patterns

gift_card_thresholds.notes: Per FINTRAC Guideline 2 indicators of money laundering. Alert when either threshold is exceeded.
